name: browser-interaction-review
purpose: Focused browser/game integration checklist: composition root, event state, pointer lock, visibility, restart and fake adapter tests.
pre_prompt: For browser adapters, verify composition-root initialization actually runs and matches public signatures. Keep imports inert and DOM/RAF injectable. Mouse displacement is consumed once per frame; keyboard turning is a rate. Pointer-lock rejection needs a usable fallback and resume needs a fresh user gesture. Pause on focus loss, cap delta time, and reset state through the accepted factory. Preserve live state references after restart. Verify computed overlay visibility and real clicks: CSS display:flex can override hidden. Test handlers and startup with fake adapters, then validate browser behavior; symbol presence alone is insufficient.
post_prompt: These are review obligations, not proof of a browser test. Record actual checks and failures; never claim unexecuted checks passed.
